lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zr10Al4Ru2 (reduced formula Zr5Al2Ru) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4₁md (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (2 Al, 6 Ru, 4 Zr), Ru centers with 9 neighbors (4 Al, 5 Zr), and Zr centers with 12, 16, or 18 neighbors, with the 12- and 16-neighbor Zr environments identified as close-packed-like and body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and face sharing between Al 12-vertex and Zr 16-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Zr 16-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions.
